criticism: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initialSupply is added to the balanceOf[target] without a check, allowing the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user's balance to any arbitrary value.
The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balanceOf[_to] += _value; can overflow if balanceOf[_to] is at maximum uint256, causing a buyout attack.
The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balanceOf[_to] += _value; can overflow if balanceOf[_to] is at maximum uint256, causing a buyout attack.
The buy function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The amount = msg.value / buyPrice; can overflow if buyPrice is set to 0, allowing attackers to buy out the contract owner's assets.
The sell function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The amount * sellPrice overflows if sellPrice is set to 0, allowing attackers to sell out the contract owner's assets.
